scores.tell: Mid-bright key with a mild orange vignette; hero's dark purple dials and deep blue headphones are fairly hard accents, slightly more contrast than real cards.
The red-to-peach split background and the dark grey legs and feet cast a strong shadow. The hard horizon line makes a two-band value layout unlike the real cards' soft glow behind the hero.
The near-black cat on a bright yellow stripe background gives a very hard hero/background gap. The cat body is a large dark mass, darker than real cards' hero values.
none; bright key, a green radial glow behind the star, gentle local contrast, and small dark accents under the points match the real cards.
Dark navy spotlight body and deep blue lower-right corner give a heavy vignette. The pale beam is faint and washes out against the background.
The teal background is flat with no glow. The dark door slats and the horizon split at mid-height make hard, graphic bands.
The whole card is mid-key with orange wood and teal water. The snorkel's deep blue is a bit saturated, and the clear mask blends into the wood, so the hero's edge is soft.
Bright key, with a white tube against teal stripes giving clear value and hue separation. The dark grey mount is a small, sensible accent, and the floor is slightly flat.
none; a bright magenta radial glow behind the palm, light sand at the bottom, gentle local contrast, and small dark accents in the leaf folds.
Bright, evenly lit scene like the real swing card. The grey stone hero is a bit close in value to the grass and has little separation, but the dark board gives a good accent.
